records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Studio!
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Open cancellation request (tick_d454f87f1ae0, email:8458fdc4) signals intent to leave; 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome call (calendar:1034c66d) and multiple nudges (email:a8e92faa, aed3ab68). Only 8 days left; unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Following up on bulk import and your questions
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for raising both the bulk import question and the cancellation timing one 
s- both tickets are still open on our side, and Tariq confirmed that teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. On timing, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately.

If it's useful, I'd be glad to hop on a short call this week to help you get a first project set up with your team in it, so you can judge Wrenfield on real work before deciding.

Best,
Nadia
